title: GN&C IV Follow-On
agency_path: NATIONAL AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADMINISTRATION.NATIONAL AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADMINISTRATION.NASA JOHNSON SPACE CENTER
detail_text: This is an Intent to Sole Source Notice. NASA/Johnson Space Center (JSC) has a requirement for continued services regarding the development, maintenance, and application of Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GN&C) products and services. NASA/JSC intends to issue a sole source new follow-on contract to acquire services from The Charles Stark Draper Laboratory, Inc. under the authority of FAR 6.103-1. Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. The Government does not intend to acquire a commercial product or service using FAR Part 12. Interested organizations may submit their capabilities and qualifications to perform the effort electronically via email to Mr. Jonathan Anzures at jonathan.anzures@nasa.gov and Maya Evans at maya.e.evans@nasa.gov not later than 5 p.m. CST on March 13, 2026 . Such capabilities/qualifications will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct this new work order on a competitive basis. A determination by the Government not to compete this new work order on a full and open competition basis, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. NASA Clause 1852.215-84, Ombudsman, is applicable. The Center Ombudsman for this acquisition can be found at : https://www.hq.nasa.gov/office/procurement/regs/Procurement-Ombuds-Comp-Advocate-Listing.pdf
